title: 第1061章 莫山出现第1060章 全力破界
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：穿越大乾，从病秧子开始蜕变第一卷：默认第1061章：莫山出现（..la）他的眼中……是两团如同燃烧着的暗青色火焰，在深陷的眼窝中跳动，带着一种历经数万年岁月沉淀后的锐利与苍凉。
身着一件暗青色道袍，道袍上没有任何纹饰，只有衣襟处绣着几道早已看不清原貌的残破符线。
站在那里，如同一截被雷击后枯立在荒原上万年的古木，虽已枯萎，却依旧散发着一种不容侵犯的气息。
莫山。
圣教当年的最后一位大长老，上古大战中幸存下来的真正老古董。
他目光扫过正在忙碌的圣教弟子，扫过沐清漪那张苍白却坚定的面容，扫过正在拼命以自身元力填补封印裂纹的长老。
那双燃烧着暗青色火焰的眼睛中，闪过一丝极其明显、复杂的情绪。
他的声音沙哑而低沉，如同枯叶摩擦般干涩，“真的还要守吗？”
话音微微一顿，目光最终落在方云逸身上。
那双暗青色的眼睛与方云逸深邃如渊的目光在半空中交汇，片刻之后，莫山缓缓开口，声音中带着一种无法言喻的苍凉！
“本座方才对天雪子说的话，并非全是虚张声势。
这道封印……碎了便碎了。
本座当年为它流过血，耗尽过命，换来的又是什么？”
他缓缓迈步，枯瘦如柴的手指抬起，指向远处正在拼命填补封印裂纹的圣教弟子。
“当年上古大战，圣教上下倾尽全力镇守此界，以无数先辈的命填进这道封印里，才勉强将它稳住。
可那些禁区……天雪宫、万古荒原、幽冥山脉、金阙、苍梧秘境……”
“一个都没有来。”
他的声音骤然变得冷厉，如同刀刃刮过铁石，“不仅没来，那些临阵倒戈的叛徒，那些在关键时刻撤走防线的所谓盟友……”
“他们才是真正让此界本源崩碎、规则残缺的元凶之一。”
“当年本座亲眼看着同门在封印前被异族撕成碎片，看着那些临阵退缩的势力撤走之后留下的空荡防线，看着异界大军从那些缺口长驱直入……”
莫山的声音变得沙哑，燃烧着暗青色火焰的眼睛中浮现出一种深入骨髓的疲惫。
“本座已不在乎这封印。
它碎也好，此界生灵沦为异族口粮也好……本座只想守着圣教剩下的这点火种，不管它们逃到哪里去。”
沐清漪的嘴唇动了动，却没有出声。
方云逸沉默过后，却是忽然开口，“莫山前辈，您或许是对的。
当年恩怨，我不曾经历过，无法评说。
但此刻……”
他抬头，目光与莫山那双燃烧着暗青色火焰的眼睛对视，声音带着坚定！
“莫山前辈，我方才在大战之时，以此封印为要挟，说要将此界亿万生灵都拖下水陪葬，那是我被逼到绝境之下的无奈抉择。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Traveling through Daqian, starting from a sick man, Volume 1: Default Chapter 1061: Mo Shan appears (..la) In his eyes... there were two groups of dark blue flames that were like burning, beating in the deep eye sockets, with a sharpness and desolation that had accumulated over tens of thousands of years.
Wearing a dark blue Taoist robe, there are no patterns on the Taoist robe, only a few broken talisman lines embroidered on the skirt, whose original appearance can no longer be seen clearly.
Standing there, it was like an ancient tree that had been standing in the wilderness for thousands of years after being struck by lightning. Although it had withered, it still exuded an aura of inviolability.
Mo Shan.
The last great elder of the Holy Religion, a true antique who survived the ancient war.
He glanced at the busy Holy Cult disciples, at Mu Qingyi's pale but determined face, and at the elders who were desperately using their own energy to fill the cracks in the seal.
An extremely obvious and complex emotion flashed through those eyes burning with dark blue flames.
"You..."
His voice was hoarse and low, as dry as the friction of dead leaves, "Do you really want to keep it?"
There was a slight pause in his words, and his eyes finally fell on Fang Yunyi.
Those dark green eyes and Fang Yunyi's deep gaze met in mid-air. After a moment, Mo Shan slowly spoke, with an indescribable desolation in his voice!
“What I just said to Tian Xuezi was not all bluff.
This seal... will be broken if it is broken.
I shed my blood and spent my life for it, but what did I get in return? "
He stepped forward slowly, raising his skinny fingers and pointing at the Holy Cult disciples in the distance who were desperately trying to fill the cracks in the seal.
"In the ancient war, the Holy Cult devoted all their strength to guard this world, filling this seal with the lives of countless ancestors, and then barely stabilizing it.
But those restricted areas... Tianxue Palace, Eternal Wasteland, Netherworld Mountains, Golden Tower, Cangwu Secret Realm..."
"None came."
His voice suddenly became cold and stern, like a blade scraping against iron stone, "Not only did they not come, but those traitors who defected before the battle, those so-called allies who withdrew their defenses at the critical moment..."
"They are one of the real culprits that caused the origin of this world to collapse and the rules to be incomplete."
"Back then, I saw with my own eyes that my fellow sect members were torn into pieces by the aliens before they were sealed. I saw the empty defense lines left behind after the retreating forces retreated. I watched the alien armies march straight in through those gaps..."
Mo Shan's voice became hoarse, and a bone-deep exhaustion appeared in his eyes burning with dark cyan flames.
"I no longer care about this seal.
Whether it is broken into pieces, or whether the creatures in this world become food for aliens... I just want to guard the remaining fire of the Holy Religion, no matter where they escape. "
Mu Qingyi's lips moved, but she made no sound.
After Fang Yunyi was silent, he suddenly spoke, "Senior Mo Shan, you may be right.
I have never experienced the grudges back then and cannot comment on them.
But at this moment..."
He raised his head and looked into Mo Shan's eyes burning with dark blue flames, his voice was firm!
"Senior Mo Shan, during the war, I used this seal as a threat and said that I would drag down hundreds of millions of living beings in this world to be buried with them. That was a helpless decision made by me when I was forced into a desperate situation."
